name: Expert_AH_HM_MFI
summary: This EA uses the MFI (Money Flow Index) smoothed by a Moving Average as a momentum-based signal filter within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework. It opens and closes trades based on threshold values applied to the CH_HM_MFI signal, with fixed lot money management and no trailing stop.
summary_zh: 该EA使用经过移动平均平滑处理的MFI（资金流量指数）作为动量信号过滤器，在MQL5标准库Expert框架内运行。根据CH_HM_MFI信号的阈值开仓和平仓，采用固定手数资金管理，无追踪止损。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于资金流量指数（MFI）的动量判断，通过将MFI值经过移动平均（MA）平滑处理后生成交易信号。入场条件是当CH_HM_MFI过滤器的信号强度超过开仓阈值（默认40）时开仓，信号强度低于平仓阈值（默认20）时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式（默认0.1手），不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理使用MoneyFixedLot模块，设定百分比为10%，固定手数为0.1手。止损和止盈均设为0，意味着不使用固定的止损止盈，完全依赖信号反转来平仓。挂单有效期为4根K线周期，未设置追踪止损，风险控制主要依赖信号阈值过滤。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum judgment using the Money Flow Index (MFI), smoothed by a Moving Average to generate trading signals. Entry conditions trigger when the CH_HM_MFI filter's signal strength exceeds the opening threshold (default 40), and positions close when signal strength falls below the closing threshold (default 20). Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach (default 0.1 lots) without dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management employs the MoneyFixedLot module with a percentage setting of 10% and a fixed lot size of 0.1. Both Stop Loss and Take Profit are set to 0, meaning no fixed stop-loss or take-profit is used, relying entirely on signal reversal for exit. Pending order expiration is set to 4 bars, and no trailing stop is configured, with risk control primarily depending on signal threshold filtering.
pros: 使用MFI结合MA平滑，减少虚假信号干扰，提高信号质量
基于MQL5标准库Expert框架开发，代码结构规范，模块化程度高
信号阈值可调，提供灵活的入场/出场控制，适应不同市场环境
pros_en: MFI combined with MA smoothing reduces false signals and improves signal quality
Built on the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework with well-structured, modular code architecture
Adjustable signal thresholds provide flexible entry/exit control adaptable to different market conditions
cons: 止损和止盈均设为0，完全依赖信号平仓，在极端行情中可能造成重大损失
固定手数策略不根据账户规模和波动率动态调整，资金管理过于简单
未设置追踪止损，无法在趋势行情中锁定浮动利润
cons_en: Stop Loss and Take Profit are both set to 0, relying entirely on signal reversal for exits, which can cause significant losses in extreme market conditions
Fixed lot sizing does not dynamically adjust based on account size or volatility, making money management overly simplistic
No trailing stop configured, unable to lock in floating profits during trending markets
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，建议至少设置基于ATR的动态止损以控制单笔风险
引入追踪止损模块替代TrailingNone，以便在趋势行情中保护利润
improvements_en: Add Stop Loss and Take Profit parameters; recommend at least ATR-based dynamic stop-loss to control per-trade risk
Replace TrailingNone with a trailing stop module to protect profits during trending markets

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，在突发事件或剧烈波动时无保护机制，可能导致大额亏损
固定手数不考虑账户权益变化，连续亏损时风险敞口不会自动缩小
risk_points_en: Stop Loss and Take Profit are both 0, providing no protection during sudden events or extreme volatility, potentially leading to large losses
Fixed lot sizing does not account for account equity changes, meaning risk exposure does not automatically decrease during consecutive losses

summary_en: This EA uses the MFI (Money Flow Index) smoothed by a Moving Average as a momentum-based signal filter within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert framework. It opens and closes trades based on threshold values applied to the CH_HM_MFI signal, with fixed lot money management and no trailing stop.
